responsibility: Implements classic human-readable stderr diagnostics as a concrete sink. This file owns text-specific buffering, message prefix construction, include/module stack reporting, emission of the formatted diagnostic text, optional CWE/rule/option annotations, source-locus printing via diagnostic_show_locus, nested-diagnostic indentation, path printing hooks, and the default text starter/finalizer callbacks, making it the main traditional textual output backend for GCC diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Implements the text_sink interface declared in text-sink.h, including the private buffering subclass, diagnostic emission flow, include/module stack reporting, option/CWE/rule annotations, and default text starter/finalizer functions. Unlike the header, this .cc is the concrete text-output backend implementation.
